parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the refrigerator is made of stainless steel, forming the main structural body that supports all internal and external components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides rigidity, houses insulation, and supports the door and internal compartments.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The door of the refrigerator is made of stainless steel and is attached to the frame via hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the refrigerator’s interior, maintaining the internal temperature when closed and providing insulation.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about its hinges to open and close, allowing user access to the interior.
